WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as distinct_transreg_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(distinct_transreg_count) as total_sum
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.tradekind,
  step1.distinct_transreg_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN step2.total_sum IS NOT NULL AND step2.total_sum > 0
    THEN CAST(step1.distinct_transreg_count AS REAL) / CAST(step2.total_sum AS REAL)
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.total_sum IS NOT NULL
